predecessors.name: Kievan Rus'
predecessors.text: Peremyshl and the upper San-Dniester country, a Rus' town since 'Vladimir marched up the Lyachs and took their cities: Peremyshl, Cherven' (981, Primary Chronicle, Peremyshl page) and 'recaptured by…

successors.name: Principality of Halych
successors.text: Peremyshl, united in 1141 with Terebovlia and Zvenyhorod to form the Principality of Halych

ledger.x: 1056: Peremyshl enters the map as a principality of its own, the Rostislavichi's land on the upper San.
1084: Terebovlia is carved out as an appanage for Vasylko Rostyslavych.
1141: Peremyshl joins Terebovlia and Zvenyhorod in the Principality of Halych.
1141: the Principality of Peremyshl ends in the unified Galician principality.

wars.name: Siege of Peremyshl (1097)
wars.outcome: Yaroslav Svyatopolkovich, allied with Coloman of Hungary, besieged the city, which Volodar defended; Davyd Svyatoslavich and his Polovtsy ally Bonyak defeated the Hungarians.

certainty.note: Carpathian and river frontiers with Hungary, Poland and the Cumans, never fixed by treaty or survey on the pages opened; the Cherven and Zvenyhorod marches are the softest.
